overview: The paper demonstrates that downgrading optimizer grade (from second-order to first-order to zeroth-order or compressed-gradient variants) enhances LLM unlearning robustness against post-unlearning weight perturbations, and proposes a hybrid FO-ZO optimizer that alternates first-order and zeroth-order updates to achieve both effective unlearning and strong robustness.

modules.name: Unlearning Data Loading and Preprocessing
modules.description: Handles loading, tokenization, and batch construction for MUSE (Books/News), WMDP, and TOFU benchmarks, including forget set, retain set, and relearn set partitioning with custom Dataset and DataLoader implementations.

modules.name: Unlearning Objective Functions
modules.description: Implements the core unlearning loss formulations including GradDiff (gradient difference between forget and retain losses), NPO (negative preference optimization treating forget data as negative samples), and RMU (representation misdirection), each computing forget loss and retain loss with configurable regularization weighting.

modules.name: Zeroth-Order Gradient Estimation
modules.description: Implements ZO gradient estimation via finite differences of objective function values over random direction vectors sampled from the unit sphere, including the AdaZO variance-reduced variant with adaptive step sizes, and the theoretical connection to randomized smoothing of the original objective.

modules.name: Gradient-Compressed Optimizer Variants
modules.description: Implements compressed-gradient optimizers including signSGD (1-bit gradient quantization), signAdam (1-bit Adam momentum quantization), and 8-bit Adam (block-wise 8-bit gradient compression), where the quantization operator maps full-precision descent directions to low-bit representations.

modules.name: First-Order and Second-Order Baseline Optimizers
modules.description: Wraps standard FO optimizer (Adam) and SO optimizer (Sophia) as unlearning optimizers, as well as the FO randomized smoothing (RS) optimizer that minimizes a smoothed version of the unlearning objective by adding Gaussian perturbations, serving as the FO counterpart to ZO.

modules.name: Hybrid FO-ZO Optimizer
modules.description: Implements the hybrid optimization strategy that alternates between FO (Adam by default) and ZO (AdaZO by default) updates following a leader-follower game rationale, where FO provides high-precision unlearning as the follower and ZO drives robustness as the leader, with configurable switch step sizes and independent FO/ZO step ratios.

modules.name: Unlearning Training Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrates the full unlearning training loop including epoch/step management, optimizer scheduling, gradient accumulation, checkpoint saving at configurable intervals, best-model selection based on retain performance, and support for all optimizer variants through a unified interface.

modules.name: Quantization Robustness Evaluation
modules.description: Implements post-unlearning weight quantization via GPTQ to compress full-precision unlearned model weights into lower bit-widths, and evaluates unlearning metric degradation before and after quantization to assess robustness against unintentional weight perturbations from model compression.

modules.name: Relearning Attack Simulation
modules.description: Implements relearning attack evaluation by fine-tuning the unlearned model on subsets of the forget set or retain set for a configurable number of steps, measuring how much forgotten information resurfaces, supporting both worst-case (forget set) and general (retain set) relearning scenarios.

modules.name: Unlearning Metrics Computation
modules.description: Implements all unlearning-specific evaluation metrics: VerbMem (verbatim memorization on forget set via prefix-based generation and exact match), KnowMem (knowledge memorization on forget set via QA-style evaluation), retain KnowMem (utility preservation on retain set), MMLU accuracy, ROUGE-L, probability on forget set, and composite Model Utility score.

modules.name: General Utility Evaluation
modules.description: Integrates with lm-eval-harness to evaluate general model capabilities on Hellaswag (commonsense reasoning), TruthfulQA (factual truthfulness), and ARC-Challenge (scientific QA), ensuring that optimizer downgrading and hybrid optimization do not unnecessarily compromise broader model competence.

modules.name: Linear Mode Connectivity Analysis
modules.description: Implements LMC analysis between unlearned models from different optimizers by linearly interpolating their parameters and evaluating unlearning metrics along the interpolation path, determining whether two optimizers converge to the same or distinct loss landscape basins.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Provides configurable ablation experiment runners for hybrid optimizer design choices: switch step size variations, FO/ZO step ratio comparisons, and the impact of starting optimizer order, with automated result collection and comparison across configurations.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Results Aggregation
modules.description: Manages YAML/JSON-based experiment configurations for all benchmark-method-optimizer combinations, handles experiment logging and tracking, aggregates results across runs, and generates formatted LaTeX tables and comparison plots (performance before/after quantization, relearning curves, LMC plots) for final reporting.
